name: co2-ppm
title: Mauna Loa Monthly Atmospheric CO2
description: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory monthly mean and deseasonalized atmospheric CO2, March 1958–July 2026, with measurement-day counts, standard deviation and uncertainty where available. Snapshot retrieved 2026-08-30; source file created 2026-08-05. March 1958–April 1974 data originate with C. David Keeling, Scripps Institution of Oceanography. Monthly means are corrected to the center of the month and source-interpolated values are retained. Observations from December 2022 through July 4, 2023 were taken at Maunakea Observatories during the Mauna Loa interruption. Empty cells represent unavailable statistics, not zero.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar month represented by its first day (YYYY-MM-01); this is a monthly mean, not a daily observation.

fields.name: decimal_year
fields.description: Source decimal date in years, preserved at the supplied precision.

fields.name: average_ppm
fields.description: Monthly mean atmospheric CO2 in parts per million, corrected to the center of the month. Source-interpolated monthly values are retained. The skill-documented -99.99 missing marker is supported; none occurs in this snapshot.

fields.name: deseasonalized_ppm
fields.description: Source deseasonalized monthly CO2 in parts per million. The skill-documented -99.99 missing marker is supported; none occurs in this snapshot.

fields.name: measurement_days
fields.description: Source ndays: number of days with measurements. Source -1 becomes empty; zero remains zero. Scripps-era counts are unavailable.

fields.name: standard_deviation_ppm
fields.description: Source sdev in parts per million. Source -9.99 becomes empty; negative values indicate unavailable Scripps statistics or interpolated NOAA months, per the source header.

fields.name: uncertainty_ppm
fields.description: Source unc in parts per million. Source -0.99 becomes empty; negative values indicate unavailable Scripps statistics or interpolated NOAA months, per the source header. The header does not specify a confidence level.
